analysis.hypothesis: The model requires a fused sum reduction along dimension 1 (channels) followed by sigmoid. Since the input is large (512x3x512x512 float32), a single fused CUDA kernel that performs the sum and sigmoid can avoid intermediate memory traffic and launch overhead, achieving better performance than separate kernels. The custom_sum_only and custom_sigmoid_only operators are also needed for debug_forward, so we implement them as separate launchers with their own kernels.
